Ptype: AllowExchange_Dynamic
Description: [[Used for dynamic simulations in some algorithms involving terrestrial plants 
to indicate whether it is the growing season for plants.  This property is 
only used for dynamic simulations, but must be defined for both dynamic and

season for a non-evergreen plant compartment and 0 if it is not.]]
   DataType: FloatingPoint
      Units: N/A
   Min: 0.0

   Min: 0.0

Ptype: AllowExchange_SteadyState_forAir
Description: [[Used for steady-state simulations in algorithms involving transport of 
chemical mass from air to terrestrial plants to indicate whether it is the 
growing season for plants.  This property is only used for steady-state 
simulations, but must be defined for both dynamic and steady-state 
simulations.  This property can be set to any floating point number between 
0.0 and 1.0 to indicate the fraction of each year made up by the growing 
season (1.0 = 100% of the year would be the growing season, 0.0 = 0% of the 
year, 0.5 = 50% of the year).]]
   DataType: FloatingPoint
      Units: N/A
   Min: 0.0
   Max: 1.0

Ptype: AllowExchange_SteadyState_forOther
Description: [[Used for steady-state simulations in some algorithms involving terrestrial 
plants (but not those involving transport of chemical mass from air to 
terrestrial plants) to indicate whether it is the growing season for plants.

for both dynamic and steady-state simulations.  This property can be set to 
any floating point number between 0.0 and 1.0 to indicate the fraction of 
each year made up by the growing season (1.0 = 100% of the year would be the 
growing season, 0.0 = 0% of the year, 0.5 = 50% of the year).]]
   DataType: FloatingPoint
